description: Local, read-only Gantt preview fixture. One 40-gallon mixer runs 24–27 batches in one six-hour daily block. Each of 12 orders has three consecutive daily batch cycles: prep the calendar day before mixing, one-hour pre/post-op, package the next day, then final pickup. No records are persisted. IDs use a dedicated synthetic range.
loadingNotes: Rebase calendar dates from anchorDate to the selected demo start and replace facilityId with the selected facility. These arrays match the Scheduler presentation contracts; all work links resolve to customerOrders. Mark assignments as published except draftAssignmentIds. Scheduling/persistence actions must remain disabled for fixture rows. This calendar-day capacity preview includes weekend operation; each mixer block is unique to one order and production totals reconcile customer demand plus stored overage.
